title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
statement: Return the number of nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path. An empty tree has depth 0.
hints: The depth of a node is 1 plus the deeper child.
BFS counts layers and returns the number of layers.

approaches.name: BFS layers
approaches.explanation: The last layer index is the depth.

editorial: max_depth(null) = 0 and max_depth(node) = 1 + max(max_depth(left), max_depth(right)). That is the whole algorithm. It is also the template for height-based tree DP.

examples.explanation: The longest path has three nodes.
